case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the staff’s friendliness and attentive customer care, cleanliness, the pleasant outdoor/pool and bar areas, and the breakfast’s quality and variety; several noted the family-friendly atmosphere. Recurring negative feedback concerned noise. Isolated complaints included an uncomfortable bed causing back pain and a sudden scalding shower. A few reviewers reported no issues and overall satisfaction.
